hooks.command: /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; run() { local candidate="$1"; shift; if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then exec "$candidate" "$@"; fi; if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then exec node "$candidate" "$@"; fi; }; if [ -n "${HRP_CLI:-}" ]; then run "$HRP_CLI" hook stop --agent codex; fi; if command -v hrp >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$(command -v hrp)" hook stop --agent codex; fi; if [ -n "${HOME:-}" ]; then run "$HOME/.local/bin/hrp" hook stop --agent codex; fi; search_dir="$PWD"; for _attempt in {1..8}; do if [ -f "$search_dir/bin/hrp.mjs" ]; then exec node "$search_dir/bin/hrp.mjs" hook stop --agent codex; fi; parent="$(dirname "$search_dir")"; [ "$parent" != "$search_dir" ] || break; search_dir="$parent"; done; echo "Error: no se encontró el CLI hrp; define HRP_CLI o instala HRP." >&2; exit 0'
